description: Install labsUI items into the project: copies each item and everything it imports, then installs their npm packages. Existing files are kept, never overwritten. Returns the files written, the packages installed, dependencies kept that differ from this version (call update on them) and anything to mount once in the root layout. Needs init first; dryRun previews. To bring installed items to a newer version, use update instead.

dryRun.description: Report what would change, write nothing.

names.description: Item names as search lists them, e.g. button or date-picker.
